title: Specify direction-specific RX integration needs
description:
Produce a proposed direction-specific integration/coexistence contract from actual receiver evidence. Identify which endpoint can receive each uplink/downlink waveform and how ordinary LoRa shares finite resources. Hand requirements to existing project-LICHEN-worker6-b7z9.78 rather than duplicating its implementation.

HPC8 execution policy: Code, test, or schema changes require three independent correctness, security, and robustness reviews; file and fix all findings and re-review. Use independent oracles, never weakened legacy tests or self-generated expected results. Preserve upstream Yggdrasil addressing, radio-owned identity, best-effort custody, baseline SCHC, and the human-only OSCORE/EDHOC security edit bar. External actions, hardware/RF operations, and port access require scoped explicit permission and applicable bench safety checks. Research may conclude no-go; an authorization gate requires affirmative, recorded approval for its actual scope. Dependency closure and decomposition are not permission. No speculative activation, including deferred portability or experimental modes.
design: Research proposal only; no new flag allocation, normative profile or baseline negotiation change is approved. Finalized wire.12 provides the integration boundary, not permission to activate LR-FHSS. No hardware or external action occurs.
acceptance_criteria: Independent capability and resource tables reject TX-only endpoints masquerading as LR-FHSS receivers. Identify legacy downlink-matches-uplink and generic capability-bit assumptions needing human-reviewed revision. Distinguish an uplink-only gateway experiment from a bidirectional peer mesh and record unsupported outcomes.
